|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">惑星オルデランの破壊は、フォースの流れに大きな乱れを引き起こした。数百万の声が一瞬にして叫び、そして途絶えたのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' A Disturbance In The Force.

'''Card text:''' During your deploy phase, insert this card face down into the opponent's Reserve Deck and shuffle. The opponent then cuts without looking. When this card reaches the top, it goes to the Lost Pile. The opponent may not activate more Force that turn. Immune to Alter.

'''Lore:''' The destruction of Alderaan caused a great disturbance in the Force. Millions of voices cried out at once and were suddenly silenced.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 意識操作 for Alter.
